items.title: What Do Kimberly Clark (KMB) New Leadership Appointments Mean For Growth?
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (NasdaqGS:KMB) has appointed Katie Devine as Chief Growth & Innovation Officer to lead global category strategy and R&D. Brian Giroux has been named Chief Customer Officer with responsibility for commercial transformation, trade optimization and global customer development. Both executives will join Kimberly-Clark's Enterprise Leadership Team and report directly to the Chief Executive Officer.
